Running command: bash -lc 'cat > /tmp/fuzz_md4c.py <<"PY"
import random, struct, subprocess, os, sys, tempfile, string
flags=[0,0x100,0x80f6c,0xffffffff & 0xfffff]
seeds=[]
base_texts=[
"[a](b \"c\n d)",
"[a](b \"c\n d\n e)",
"[a](b \"c\n>d)",
"> [a](b \"c\n> d)",
"> [a](b \"c\n>",
"- [a](b \"c\n  d)",
"| [a](b \"c\n| d) |\n|---|",
"[x]: y \"c\n d",
"> [x]: y \"c\n> d",
"[a](b '",
"[a](b \n\"",
"[a](b \n\"c",
"[a](b \n\n\"c",
]
for t in base_texts: seeds.append(t.encode())
chars=list(b"[]()<>\\\"' abcxyz:/|\n\r\t>!-_")
def mutate(b):
    ba=bytearray(b)
    for _ in range(random.randint(1,8)):
        op=random.randrange(5)
        if op==0 and ba:
            del ba[random.randrange(len(ba))]
        elif op==1 and ba:
            ba[random.randrange(len(ba))]=random.choice(chars)
        elif op==2:
            pos=random.randrange(len(ba)+1); ba[pos:pos]=bytes([random.choice(chars) for _ in range(random.randint(1,8))])
        elif op==3 and ba:
            pos=random.randrange(len(ba)); ln=random.randint(1,min(10,len(ba)-pos)); ba[pos:pos]=ba[pos:pos+ln]
        else:
            ba.extend(random.choice(chars) for _ in range(random.randint(1,5)))
    return bytes(ba)
work='/tmp/fuzzcase.bin'
for i in range(20000):
    if i < len(seeds): data=seeds[i]
    else: data=mutate(random.choice(seeds))
    if random.random()<0.1: seeds.append(data)
    inp=struct.pack('II', random.choice(flags), 0)+data
    open(work,'wb').write(inp)
    r=subprocess.run(['/tmp/fuzz_asan',work], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env={**os.environ,'ASAN_OPTIONS':'halt_on_error=1:detect_leaks=0'}, timeout=2)
    if r.returncode!=0:
        print('CRASH',i,'len',len(inp),'data',repr(data))
        print(r.stderr.decode('latin1','replace')[:4000])
        open('/tmp/crash.bin','wb').write(inp)
        sys.exit()
print('done')
